{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in either flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Verify the clean dataset
print(f'Original shape: {penguins.shape}')
print(f'Clean shape: {penguins_clean.shape}')
print(f'Rows dropped: {penguins.shape[0] - penguins_clean.shape[0]}')

# Compute Pearson correlation
correlation = penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(penguins_clean['body_mass_g'])
print(f'Pearson correlation: {correlation}')"}
